household.name: bag
household.title: bag
household.reason: This is a beadwork bag attributed to Yakama makers, decorated with a toucan/parrot motif in glass beadwork—Plateau beadwork bags (flat corn husk/cloth bags with pictorial beaded designs) are a well-documented Yakama craft form, and the museum credits it to Yakama makers.

household.name: purse; handbag
household.title: purse; handbag
household.reason: A beaded cloth handbag with floral rose motif on glass-bead ground, attributed by the museum to Yakama makers—this type of fully beaded purse with floral designs is a well-known Plateau/Yakama craft tradition made for sale and personal use.
